fluidgore.settings.title: Fluid Gore Settings
fluidgore.option.gore_level.tooltip: Scales blood amount, puddle size, how many parts come off and how long everything stays. Off disables everything and removes existing blood and parts.
fluidgore.option.affect_players.tooltip: Players bleed and can lose parts when killed with a blade.
fluidgore.option.affect_mobs.tooltip: Hostile mobs bleed and can lose parts.
fluidgore.option.affect_animals.tooltip: Passive and neutral creatures (animals, villagers...) bleed and can lose parts.
fluidgore.option.blood_color.tooltip: Blood color of players and passive creatures.
fluidgore.option.blood_style.tooltip: Redstone: blocky pixel-art splats like redstone dust. Realistic: smooth round splats. Mixed: a random mix of both.
fluidgore.option.gore_chunks.tooltip: Heavy hits and kills throw crumbs of redstone block (or a block matching the blood colour) and bits of meat.
fluidgore.option.arterial_spurts.tooltip: Bad wounds and severed limbs pump blood out in pulsing jets.
fluidgore.option.gore_sounds.tooltip: Wet crunching on heavy hits, kills and dismemberment.
fluidgore.option.persistence.tooltip: How long blood stays on the ground at Medium before fading. Higher gore levels keep it longer.
fluidgore.option.max_decals.tooltip: Cap on blood splats plus puddle cells. The oldest are removed first.
fluidgore.option.wall_splatter.tooltip: Blood sticks to walls and runs down ledges.
fluidgore.option.directional_spatter.too: Blood that lands at a slant stretches into a teardrop whose tail points the way it flew.
fluidgore.option.drag_trails.tooltip: A bleeding body that slides, tumbles or is shoved over the ground smears a trail of blood behind it.
fluidgore.option.footprints.tooltip: Anything walking through a puddle leaves a few footprints.
fluidgore.option.rain_washes.tooltip: Blood exposed to rain fades much faster.
fluidgore.option.cleaning.tooltip: Hold a sponge or brush (cleaningItems in the config) and use it on blood to wipe it away. The tool soaks up what it wipes: the bloodier it gets, the more it smears blood and guts along the floor instead. Use it on water to wash it. Sneak to use the item normally.
fluidgore.option.cells_per_tick.tooltip: How many puddle cells the blood flow simulation may update per tick. Lower is cheaper.
fluidgore.option.max_droplets.tooltip: Cap on flying blood droplets at once.
fluidgore.option.part_lifetime.tooltip: How long severed limbs and pieces stay at Medium before fading, up to an hour. Ten minutes by default.
fluidgore.option.max_parts.tooltip: Cap on severed parts in the world. The oldest are removed first.
fluidgore.option.play_with_parts.tooltip: Punch severed parts (attack), pick them up and throw them (use), kick them by walking into them and stomp them by landing on them.
fluidgore.option.blast_gore.tooltip: Explosions are graded by how close each body was. Point blank, an animal bursts into pieces of muscle, fat, bone, hide, gut, half-digested grass and organs, in the proportions a real body is made of. Close by, its limbs and head are torn off and its belly opened, and the body is thrown. Further off, it is wounded and thrown. Medium gore level and up; never players.
fluidgore.option.max_giblets.tooltip: Cap on the small pieces of flesh and bone from blasts, picks and axes. The oldest go first.
fluidgore.option.wounds.tooltip: Every blow lands where you aimed it on the body and leaves a wound there that worsens with each blow to the same spot: bruise, gash, open meat, then bone. A blade through a wound that cannot get any deeper takes the limb or head off. The Gore Level sets how deep wounds go: Low stops at gashes, Medium at open meat, High and Extreme reach the bone. Works on living animals and on bodies after death.
fluidgore.option.wound_hostiles.tooltip: Show wounds on hostile mobs too: zombies rot open, husks split open to a sickly ooze, skeletons scuff and crack.
fluidgore.option.inventory_sorting.toolt: A small sort button on chests and next to your inventory, and middle-click to sort. Stacks are merged and ordered by item id, like 1.7.10. Uses ordinary inventory clicks, so it works on any server. The hotbar is left alone.
fluidgore.sort.chest: Sort this chest (or middle-click in it)
fluidgore.sort.inventory: Sort your inventory (or middle-click in it). The hotbar is left alone.
fluidgore.option.fractures.tooltip: Blunt blows add up on the bone they hit until it breaks with a crack: the skull caves in, the ribs stove in, a leg snaps and hangs crooked. Keep going and the head is smashed and the limb torn off.
fluidgore.option.blood_runs.tooltip: Blood from an open wound runs down the skin below it and dries where it ran. A cut throat pours down the chest and the front of the forelegs; on a body lying down it runs across the side it lies on.
fluidgore.option.pallor.tooltip: Skin goes pale as a body loses blood, and its colour comes back as it heals. Shows most on a pig and on shorn sheep; a cow or horse's coat hides most of it, and wool never changes.
fluidgore.option.butchery.tooltip: Right-click a dead chicken with an empty hand to pluck it. Cut through a carcass to the bone with a blade and it splits; a blade on any loose piece cuts it in two, down to dice.
fluidgore.option.feathers.tooltip: Blows knock feathers out of birds, wet with blood from the wound. Dying birds shed them as they flap. They drift down, lie where they land, soak up blood and rain, and scatter when you walk through them.
fluidgore.option.max_feathers.tooltip: Cap on loose feathers in the world. The oldest go first.
fluidgore.option.bloody_feathers.tooltip: A chicken's feathers soak up blood around its wounds and redden as it bleeds, and go dark and slick in the rain. Plucked or soaked, it shows how skinny it is under them.
fluidgore.option.chicken_deaths.tooltip: Chickens die as chickens do: flapping wildly on the ground, thrown about by their own wings, shedding feathers. A head off flaps longest and sprays blood; a wrung neck flops; a cut throat bleeds out first; a blow to the head stuns it.
fluidgore.option.bloody_wool.tooltip: Sheep wool soaks up blood: its own wounds, spatter from the herd around it, and pools it stands or lies in, climbing the wool from where it touched. The whole fleece reddens as it fills. Rain and water slowly wash it out.
fluidgore.option.bloody_coats.tooltip: Every animal that bleeds carries blood on its hide: spatter from its own wounds, a neighbour's blow or a blast, and up its legs from walking or lying in a pool. Water rinses it off.
fluidgore.option.blood_in_water.tooltip: Blood that reaches water clouds out in it, sinks a little and thins away over a minute or two, instead of vanishing.
fluidgore.option.glowing_ender_blood.too: Enderman blood and the raw cuts in an enderman glow violet: full brightness in the dark, and shader packs bloom it.
fluidgore.option.rotten_undead.tooltip: Zombies, drowned, zombified piglins, zoglins and zombie horses are rotting meat: wounds marbled black and green, waxy fat, putrid muscle, pus and maggots, and thick dark rotten blood.
fluidgore.option.wound_players.tooltip: Show wounds on other players. Everyone with the mod sees the same wounds in the same places; nothing changes on the server.
fluidgore.option.wounds_heal.tooltip: Wounds close as health comes back: open meat becomes a gash, a gash a bruise, then nothing. Broken bones knit. A full health bar is a whole body again.
fluidgore.option.wound_clot.tooltip: How long a living body's wounds keep dripping after the last blow. The dead still bleed out.
fluidgore.option.armor_on_parts.tooltip: Severed heads and limbs keep the armor they wore: the helmet flies off with the head, boots stay on the leg.
fluidgore.option.brutal_pvp.tooltip: A player's blade cuts other players deeper and they bleed harder. A kill on High or Extreme takes more than the limb that was struck.
fluidgore.option.hurt_screen.tooltip: When you are hit, chunky pixel blood is thrown across your screen from the side the blow came from and runs down it. A fall splashes the bottom. Nothing changes on the server.
fluidgore.option.heartbeat.tooltip: Below a third of your health the screen closes in red and your heart pounds, faster and louder the closer you are to death.
fluidgore.option.stagger.tooltip: How hard a blow knocks your view to the side and down. Near death your view sways as well. 0%% turns both off.
fluidgore.option.limp.tooltip: A cut or broken leg makes players and humanoid mobs limp, and your own view hitches on that leg's step. A hurt arm hangs and swings less, and a deep belly wound or a body near death is held with the other hand.
fluidgore.option.bloody_clothes.tooltip: Blood from every open wound soaks through a player's jacket, sleeves and trousers and smears the armour over it. It goes as the wound heals.
fluidgore.option.suffering_level.tooltip: Farm animals scream, flinch, tremble, limp, panic when others are slaughtered and go through death throes that depend on how they were killed. Independent of Gore Level. Off disables it.
fluidgore.option.scream_volume.tooltip: Volume of screams, whimpers and panicked bellows. Also follows the game's Friendly Creatures volume.
fluidgore.option.max_screams.tooltip: How many scream sounds may play at once. Background whimpers and bellows are dropped first.
fluidgore.option.personality.tooltip: Every animal has its own voice, nerve and way of dying, fixed by its species and identity. Two cows never scream or die alike: some bolt, some go down slowly, some fold over the wound.
fluidgore.option.grief.tooltip: A calf cries for its mother when it is hurt, and she answers. Kill a young animal and its mother grieves: head hung, turned to where it happened, calling for it again and again long after the body is gone, less often as time passes. Kill a mother and her young calls for her. This sets how long it lasts at Medium suffering. 0 turns it off. Needs Ecology.
fluidgore.option.ecology.tooltip: Animals remember killing during the session. Survivors cower and stand over bodies, mothers and young call for each other, predators take interest in fresh blood, and bodies draw flies. Pose, sound and particles only.
fluidgore.option.death_launch.tooltip: How hard the killing blow throws a body in the direction it was struck. 0% turns it off.
fluidgore.option.death_throes.tooltip: Off: the vanilla death, made gory. The animal goes red and keels over onto its side, bleeds out where it lies and stays still. On: it drops and dies in kicking, gasping throes instead.
fluidgore.option.keep_bodies.tooltip: Slaughtered animals stay where they fell, with everything done to them, until someone cleans them up with a sponge or butchers them apart. Needs Fluid Gore on the server (in singleplayer and on a LAN world you host, that is you). Everyone with the mod sees the same butchery.
fluidgore.option.body_slide.tooltip: A body that falls across stairs, a ledge or a slope slumps over the edge and slides and tumbles down step by step until it lies flat.
fluidgore.option.burning_spreads_fire.to: Needs Fluid Gore on the server. An animal running on fire lights the grass, hay, wool and wood it brushes past, and a body that died burning burns on where it lies and sets fire to what it lies against. Real fire: it spreads like any other. On a server, the server's own setting is the one that counts.
fluidgore.option.articulated_ragdoll.too: Dead bodies go limp as real ones do: the head, the trunk and every leg move on their own, each joint only as far as a real one goes, and the body falls, folds, drapes over steps and edges and settles under its own weight, never through a block. Off: the original physics, the body falling over in one piece.
fluidgore.option.ragdoll_knees.tooltip: Articulated ragdolls also bend their legs at the knee and hock (and arms at the elbow), each the way a real one bends. Off: every part of the body stays whole, as on the vanilla model.
fluidgore.option.ragdoll_debug.tooltip: Draws the boxes and joints of every articulated ragdoll: green while it moves, blue once it has come to rest, yellow for the neck. Red points are hinges (knees, hocks, elbows).
fluidgore.option.wade_slow.tooltip: How much each body you walk through slows you down. A pile of carcasses is hard going. 0% turns it off.
fluidgore.option.max_kept_bodies.tooltip: How many bodies the server keeps in each dimension. When another falls, the oldest goes up in smoke.
fluidgore.option.corpse_linger.tooltip: How long a slaughtered animal's body stays where it fell after it dies, when the server does not keep bodies. Flies gather the longer it stays.
fluidgore.option.red_death.tooltip: Dying bodies stay tinted red through their death throes, like the vanilla death.
fluidgore.option.burns.tooltip: Animals on fire char from seared through roasted brown to black and stay that way, alive or dead. They smoke and sizzle, smoulder afterwards, and leave a black scorch mark where they burn to death. Fire sears wounds shut, so burning does not bleed.
fluidgore.option.cremation.tooltip: Burn dead bodies where they lie: use a flint and steel or fire charge on one, or lay it in fire, on a campfire or in lava. The hide sears and splits over glowing cracks, the fat catches and burns on its own under thick black smoke, the limbs draw in, and it burns down to a charred, mottled skeleton (left on a campfire or in lava, the bones go on to grey and chalk white). A heavy animal burns longer and smokes far more than a small one. Water or rain puts it out; whatever is left stays charred. Hit the char to knock it off the bone, hit the bones to break them up until only ash is left. Bones and char do not slow you down.
fluidgore.option.cremation_speed.tooltip: How fast bodies burn. At 100% a chicken burns to the bone in about 16 seconds, a sheep in 50 and a cow in 100.
fluidgore.option.melting.tooltip: Players on fire burn down layer by layer, pixel by pixel: hair and clothes go first, the skin reddens, blisters, peels and chars, then burns through with glowing edges onto yellow fat that melts and drips, then red muscle that cooks brown, then the ribs, organs and bones. How deep it goes depends on the gore level and how near death the fire has brought them; burns heal as health comes back. Dying on fire, the body stays where it fell and burns down to a charred skeleton, even after the player respawns.
fluidgore.option.melting_mobs.tooltip: Zombies, piglins and every other mob shaped like a person burn the same way as players. Zombies burn in the sun, so dawn gets smoky.
fluidgore.option.melting_animals.tooltip: Sheep, pigs and cows burn through their own anatomy too. A fleece hardly flames: it smoulders under white smoke and chars off in black patches, sparing the skin under it a while. The hide blisters and splits onto the animal's own fat (a sheep's hard white suet, a pig's soft lard, a cow's yellow fat), which runs; the meat cooks from red to brown; then the ribs, the lungs and heart, the stomachs, the guts and the long bones show. The hooves are horn: they char but stay. A body burns on to a skeleton.
fluidgore.option.body_decay.tooltip: Extreme gore level only. Kept bodies and severed pieces rot the way a real carcass does, one Minecraft day for a real day: stiff with rigor, bloated green with gas, bursting, crawling with maggots and flies in a black pool of fluid, then bones and dried hide. A chicken is bones in about ten days, a pig in a month, a cow or horse in one to two. Faster in hot biomes, half as fast in water, not at all in the snow; in deserts and the Nether bodies dry out into mummies instead. Bodies keep rotting while nobody is near and while you sleep (needs Fluid Gore on the server).
fluidgore.option.decay_speed.tooltip: 1x is real time: a Minecraft day of rot per Minecraft day. Turn it up to watch it happen sooner.
fluidgore.option.death_pop.tooltip: Some bodies, when they finally go, pop in a puff of smoke and burst into their head, limbs and scraps of flesh, which you can still kick about for a while. How many: Death Pop Chance.
fluidgore.option.death_pop_chance.toolti: How many deaths end with the body bursting apart. The rest die one of nine realistic deaths (stunned, bled out, death run, downer, broken back, drowning in blood, gut-shot, agonal thrashing, brain-hurt circling) and are left lying.
fluidgore.option.herd_panic.tooltip: Animals near a slaughter tremble and bellow in fear. The more killing nearby, the worse it gets.
fluidgore.option.pressure_vessel.tooltip: An older effect, off by default; the crafted Cobble Tank replaces it. With this on, a lit 2x2 square of TNT bursts like a gas pressure vessel: bodies close in are shredded, further out they lose limbs or their eardrums burst, and casing fragments are driven in. Works on any server. Who lives and dies is still up to vanilla's TNT.
fluidgore.option.blast_deafness.tooltip: A blast loud enough leaves you deaf for a while: every other sound muffled, your ears ringing, the hearing coming back slowly. Burst eardrums take half a minute or more.
fluidgore.option.vessel_litres.tooltip: How much gas the 2x2 TNT vessel holds.
fluidgore.option.vessel_psi.tooltip: How hard the gas in the 2x2 TNT vessel is pressed. 10,000 psi is 690 bar; a scuba tank is about 3,000 psi.
fluidgore.vessel.report: Pressure vessel burst: %s L at %s psi, about %s kg of TNT. You were %s m away: %s kPa (%s psi). %s
fluidgore.vessel.shred: Nothing recognisable of a body is left that close.
fluidgore.vessel.tear: The blast wind alone tears limbs off.
fluidgore.vessel.lethal: Lungs torn apart: fatal, almost always.
fluidgore.vessel.lungs: Lungs bruised (you cough blood), eardrums burst.
fluidgore.vessel.eardrums: Eardrums burst: deaf for a while, ears bleeding.
fluidgore.vessel.ringing: Ears ringing, hearing stunned for a few seconds.
fluidgore.vessel.bang: Only a very loud bang at this distance.
fluidgore.vessel.fragment: Hit by a fragment of the casing.
fluidgore.vessel.fragments: Hit by %s fragments of the casing.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.fluidgore: Client-side cosmetic gore: blood spray, lasting blood decals, a lightweight blood fluid simulation and dismemberment. Works on vanilla servers.
fluidgore.option.identify_remains.toolti: Look at a piece of a body lying about and what it is shows over the hotbar: whose it was, which organ or bone, which side, and whether it was seared or charred. Organs and bones thrown by a blast keep their names, so a scene can be read like an investigator would: what lay nearest the charge, what flew furthest.
fluidgore.option.piece_reactions.tooltip: Organs, scraps and severed limbs react to what they lie in, wherever they came from. In a fire or on lava a piece steams while it is wet, then cooks, dries and chars; fat catches and burns on its own flame. Water puts it out, and what the heat did stays: a charred piece crumbles when it lands hard, and a cooked one has no blood left to leave. Burnt bodies give their burns to every piece cut or blown off them.
fluidgore.organ.head: head
